sentences.japanese: 君は全力を尽くしさえすればよい。
sentences.english: All you have to do is try your best.

sentences.japanese: 君は最善を尽くしさえすればよい。
sentences.english: All you have to do is do your best.

sentences.japanese: 最善を尽くす限りは援助してあげよう。
sentences.english: I'll help you so long as you do your best.

sentences.japanese: 環境を汚染しないよう我々は最善を尽くすべきである。
sentences.english: We ought to do our best not to pollute our environment.

sentences.japanese: 確かに彼は最善を尽くしたが、成功しなかった。
sentences.english: No doubt he did his best, but he didn't succeed.
